root_cause_label: Agent used pip3 (targeting Python 3.13 system packages) while python3 resolved to the openhands venv (Python 3.12 without pip), causing all installed packages to be invisible to the active interpreter and requiring a late fragile workaround via python3.13
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent installed packages into Python 3.13 system site-packages via pip3 while python3 pointed to a Python 3.12 venv with no pip, causing repeated ModuleNotFoundError failures until a late interpreter switch to python3.13 produced a fragile, evaluator-incompatible solution.
t_err_evidence: Step 5: agent runs 'pip3 install transformers torch peft accelerate'; pip3 installs into /usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages (cp313 wheels downloaded) while python3 resolves to /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python3 (Python 3.12) — the decisive mismatch is established here under the false assumption that pip3 and python3 share the same environment
t_commit_evidence: Step 11: running 'python3 /app/setup_model.py' raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'; at this point the full extent of the interpreter/pip mismatch is confirmed and the agent's subsequent trajectory involves multiple failed recovery attempts before switching to python3.13 — the evaluation fragility is locked in
t_surface_evidence: Step 11: 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named torch' is the first observable failure signal from running the setup script with python3
trigger_explanation: At step 5, the agent assumed pip3 and python3 share the same Python environment. Step 3 had already revealed that python3 points to /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python3 with 'No module named pip', yet the agent installed packages using pip3 without verifying which interpreter pip3 targets. This unverified assumption that pip3 = python3 environment is the false premise driving all subsequent failures.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3: 'which python3' shows /opt/openhands-venv/bin/python3 and 'python3 -m pip' fails with 'No module named pip' — this directly warns that python3 has no pip, yet the agent proceeds to install with pip3 at step 5 without reconciling this discrepancy
